basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old gamer and part-time freelance graphic designer from Toronto, Canada. I grew up playing a variety of MMORPGs, and currently, I'm hooked on Wizard101. When I'm not gaming, I'm exploring the latest in blockchain technology and dabbling in stock trading with platforms like Questrade. My online hours are typically in the evenings and late at night, as I juggle my freelance work during the day. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility that comes with it, allowing me to dive deep into my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, which I use in my freelance work. My gaming knowledge is largely self-taught, stemming from years of playing and participating in online communities. I've recently started educating myself about blockchain and cryptocurrencies, primarily through online resources and forums.
